component.name: Marker
component.summary: Powerful markdown editor for the GNOME desktop

description.p: Marker is a fast and powerful markdown editor designed for the GNOME desktop with real-time preview and document export capabilities.

ul.li: View and edit markdown documents
Convert markdown documents to HTML
Tex math rendering
Support for mermaid diagrams
Support for charter plots
Syntax highlighting for code blocks
Integrated sketch editor
Exports to PDF, RTF, ODT, DOCx and LaTeX
Custom CSS themes
Custom syntax themes
Figure captioning and numbering
Modernized user interface with GTK 4 and Libadwaita.
Ported live preview to WebKitGTK 6.0.
Added document outline navigation in the sidebar.
Added Find and Replace controller.
Added automatic draft caching and recovery.
Added option to trim trailing whitespace on save.
Fixed a bug where equations weren't being rendered properly.
Improved localizations.
Preview stick to the editing text better.
Fixed crash on file opening.
Added the ability to choose any view mode when launching from cli.
Added ability to export documents from the cli.
Added vim-like shortcuts (h,j,k,l,g,G) to the previewer.
Added the ability to choose any view mode when launching from cli.
Fixed a glitch where documents opened in preview mode were scrolled to the bottom.
Fixed a glitch causing two appmenus to appear in non-gnome environments.
Fixed a glitch where code blocks didn't have monospaced font in the preview with some themes.
Added right-to-left language support
Added support for beamer classes for making presentations
Users can choose between KaTeX math rendering (faster), or MathJax math rendering.
